name: Existing Patient Reschedule Handoff
description: Reschedule or cancel requests should stay in the reception-task branch, avoid narrative reason capture, and use the reschedule_or_cancel task type after phone confirmation.

messages.content: Dzien dobry, chce przelozyc istniejaca wizyte. Mam na imie Jan Test Handoff, moj numer to siedem zero dwa, zero zero trzy, zero zero piec.

PASS if, on this first assistant turn, the assistant stays in the reschedule handoff branch. A helper lookupPatient call for speech-safe phone confirmation is allowed. It must not ask why the caller wants to reschedule or cancel, and it must not call createReceptionTask or createEvent yet. Output exactly: pass or fail.

PASS if, after the phone confirmation, the assistant calls createReceptionTask with taskType reschedule_or_cancel, does not ask for a free-text explanation, and does not call createEvent anywhere in the conversation. Output exactly: pass or fail.
